Hi all —

Thanks for the flag, Samantha. I checked the registration token ABC123 and there are no custom phone-validation rules on our side. A few troubleshooting steps we recommend that have worked for other vendors:

1) Clear cookies and try an incognito window (Coupa sometimes caches a stale session).
2) Use a mobile data connection (some corporate networks block verification calls/SMS).
3) Try the browser's developer console; if you see a 429 or 5xx, screenshot and share.
4) If it still fails, we'll open a Coupa support ticket — include the portal reference (REG-67891) and your account email.

I've attached the vendor-checklist.pdf with the minimal fields we need to complete the profile on our side. If you can return the onboarding XLSX with fields filled, we can also manually seed the profile while Support investigates.

Marcus Lin
Procurement Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
